label: phase1-pr20
candidate_advance_policy: All CPU animation and matrix updates execute. Unrecorded main-canvas warmup and advance GPU submissions are omitted; render-target previews and the final full-resolution frame render normally.
non_visual_fetch_policy: Audio fetches do not block visual readiness; all requested images, scene readiness, canvas pixels and final screenshots remain checked.
environment: Headless Chromium. Software WebGL is correctness evidence, not device performance.
webgl_capture_policy: QA-only preserveDrawingBuffer retains the last actual render while animation frames are controlled. Both canvas pixels and the final PNG are checked for blank output.
